circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith, the High Court may be
pleased to issue an appropriate writ or order or direction more particularly a
writ in the nature of a Writ of Mandamus declaring the inaction of the
Respondents in payment of sanctioned R and R compensation amount of Rs.
10,00,000/- (Ten Lakh Rupees) to each Petitioner herein as entitled under
G.O.RT.No. 312, Water Resource Department, Dt. 06.07.2023 and G.O.Rt.
No. 323, Water Resources (R and R-A2) Department, dt.24.06.2020, as a
compensation for submersion of House A-277 included in S.E.S vide no. 234
of P. Ananthapuram village, Kondapuram Mandal, Kadapa District due to
development of GNSS-Gandikota Reservoir Project is illegal, arbitrary, unjust
and contrary to the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation And
Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act,
2013, the Resettlement and Rehabilitation Policy, 2005 and further violative
of Art.14, 21 and 300A of the Constitution of India and consequently to direct
the respondents to take further action and expeditiously pay the
aforementioned due amount of Rs. 10,00,000/- each to the Petitioner no. 1
and 2 herein along with interest 24 percentage per annum from the date of
acquisition till the date of actual payment and pass
Ia No: 1 Of 2025
 Petition under Section 151 Cpc praying that in the circumstances
stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be
pleased to direct Respondents herein to take further action in respect of
proceedings Ref no. C/R and R/37/2019, dt. 22.01.2022 of Respondent no. 5
and to initiate and complete the payment process for the amount of Rs.
10,00,000/- (Rupees Ten lakhs) each payable to Petitioner no.1and 2 herein,
expeditiously and pass

 3 ORDER:
During the course of hearing, learned counsel for the petitioners sought permission of this Court to withdraw the Writ Petition as cause does not survive.
Permission is accorded.
Accordingly, the Writ Petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
No costs.
